svg.title: CHB STATCOM | star-connected phase arms
svg.desc: 2 full H-bridge cells per phase arm | 4 IGBTs and 4 antiparallel diodes per cell. STAR: each phase arm ends on a common floating N node; DC capacitors are isolated per H-bridge.
